items.en_title: Los Angeles first-come deadline November 25, 2027: 68 affordable rentals
items.en_oneliner: 68 affordable rentals in Los Angeles, first-come rather than a lottery, closing November 25, 2027 — a long window, good for households that want time to prepare their paperwork.
